args.target: T017 design-system compliance: Graphite Mint tokens, Plex fonts, shell sizes

args.condition: getComputedStyle(document.body).backgroundColor === (() => { const p = document.createElement('i'); p.style.color = 'var(--bg)'; document.body.append(p); const c = getComputedStyle(p).color; p.remove(); return c; })()

getComputedStyle(document.body).color === (() => { const p = document.createElement('i'); p.style.color = 'var(--text)'; document.body.append(p); const c = getComputedStyle(p).color; p.remove(); return c; })()

getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('.gm-sidenav__item[aria-current=page]')).color === (() => { const p = document.createElement('i'); p.style.color = 'var(--neon)'; document.body.append(p); const c = getComputedStyle(p).color; p.remove(); return c; })()

getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('.repo-row__name')).color === (() => { const p = document.createElement('i'); p.style.color = 'var(--accent)'; document.body.append(p); const c = getComputedStyle(p).color; p.remove(); return c; })()

getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('.gm-nodata')).color === (() => { const p = document.createElement('i'); p.style.color = 'var(--text-dim)'; document.body.append(p); const c = getComputedStyle(p).color; p.remove(); return c; })()

getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('.warn-flag')).color === (() => { const p = document.createElement('i'); p.style.color = 'var(--warn)'; document.body.append(p); const c = getComputedStyle(p).color; p.remove(); return c; })()

getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('.repo-list')).borderTopColor === (() => { const p = document.createElement('i'); p.style.color = 'var(--line)'; document.body.append(p); const c = getComputedStyle(p).color; p.remove(); return c; })()

args.label: Fonts: IBM Plex Sans for UI, IBM Plex Mono for numbers and names, loaded locally

args.condition: document.fonts.check('400 15px "IBM Plex Sans"') && document.fonts.check('500 14px "IBM Plex Mono"') && [...document.fonts].some(f => f.family.includes('IBM Plex Sans') && f.status === 'loaded') && [...document.fonts].some(f => f.family.includes('IBM Plex Mono') && f.status === 'loaded')

args.label: Cards outlined, no drop shadows on ordinary elements

args.condition: getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('.chart-bar--current')).fill === (() => { const p = document.createElement('i'); p.style.color = 'var(--neon)'; document.body.append(p); const c = getComputedStyle(p).color; p.remove(); return c; })()

(() => { const p = document.createElement('i'); p.style.color = 'var(--neon-bar)'; document.body.append(p); const c = getComputedStyle(p).color; p.remove(); return getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('.chart-bar:not(.chart-bar--current)')).fill === c; })()

getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('.gm-strip__num--key')).color === (() => { const p = document.createElement('i'); p.style.color = 'var(--neon)'; document.body.append(p); const c = getComputedStyle(p).color; p.remove(); return c; })()
